deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

perimeter_name.description: The name of the Service Perimeter to add this resource to.
perimeter_name.rationale: Names the Service Perimeter this dry-run resource binding targets; it is a reference to another resource and platform policy does not constrain which named perimeter is used.

resource.rationale: Identifies the GCP project placed inside the dry-run perimeter; it is a reference to a specific project and cannot be constrained generically without hardcoding project numbers.
